title: TC-TNT-01-01 fails intermittently: relation "audit_entries" does not exist during tenant schema provisioning
symptom: zig build test-integration-tnt fails intermittently on TC-TNT-01-01 with POSTGRES 42P01 'relation "audit_entries" does not exist' raised from src/db/migrations.zig:484 runForSchema. Measured on main (146070c): 3 consecutive runs gave pass, fail, fail. An accompanying 23505 duplicate-key error on schema_migrations_schema_version_uq (schema_name, version)=(tenant_<uuid>, 001_event_store.sql) appears in the same runs.
reproduction: export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test; zig build test-integration-tnt   # repeat 3-5 times against the shared bpm_test DB
root_cause_analysis: NARROWED (not yet fixed). The failing assertion is preceded, in every failing run, by C23505 on schema_migrations_schema_version_uq for (tenant_<random-uuid>, 001_event_store.sql) -- a DIFFERENT random per-test UUID each run (tenant_23c4a67b..., tenant_79a3b2b0..., tenant_ff91d9ff...). That rules out stale cross-run residue: each of those schemas is created fresh by the test's own randomUuidStr(). Two callers are therefore racing on the SAME freshly-created tenant schema within a single run. The consequence is a tracking/state mismatch: 001_event_store.sql ends up RECORDED in public.schema_migrations for that schema while its tables were not created in it, so the subsequent migration doing unqualified, search_path-resolved work fails with 42P01 -- observed as both 'relation "events" does not exist' and 'relation "audit_entries" does not exist' depending on which file is reached first. runForSchema (src/db/migrations.zig:~440-490) already holds a transaction-scoped advisory lock and re-checks public.schema_migrations under that lock (the ISS-0144/GH-454 fix), so the surviving race is narrower than the one that fix addressed and needs its own diagnosis pass -- likely the interaction between the pre-loop `applied` snapshot, the per-file COMMIT boundary, and search_path state across that boundary. Confirmed NOT residue: at rest, the only tenant_% row for 001_event_store.sql is tenant_default, whose schema does exist.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration-tnt passes deterministically across at least 5 consecutive runs on a shared bpm_test database
TC-TNT-01-01 no longer fails with relation "audit_entries" does not exist
No schema_migrations_schema_version_uq duplicate-key error during tenant provisioning
pre_existing_evidence: Reproduced on main (146070c) with none of the ISS-0147 changes present: runs 2 and 3 of 3 failed. Failure path (runForSchema/migrations) is disjoint from ISS-0147's (subprocess interpreter selection).
